review.why: Plans creator and ambassador partnerships: vetting, deal structure and usage rights, briefs, disclosure rules, measurement and a run-of-show checklist.
review.summary: Maps a spectrum from paid posts to unpaid advocates, then covers finding and vetting creators by audience fit, personal outreach, compensation models and negotiable terms, and a firm disclosure section. It adds briefs that guide without scripting, an attribution plan set up before launch, an ambassador program design and references for UGC, paid-ads creators, newsletters and Telegram.
strengths: Vets audience fit and engagement, not follower count
Securing ad usage rights is named as the highest-return clause
Compliance section holds the brand responsible for creator disclosure
cautions: Price ranges are negotiation anchors only, as it says
Disclosure rules differ by country and category: legal review for regulated cases
Four reference files are not read here
